body:
More on Autrone Tinkerer (CR 16) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Autrone Tinkerer (CR 25)" but are not part of the Autrone Tinkerer (CR 16) entry, which is unchanged.

Protos
CR 25

This figure, standing tall and imposing, has a humanoid form with two powerful arms, two sturdy legs, and a pair of intricately designed wings that seem to pulse with a radiant glow. His bright orange eyes, radiating an intense, almost divine intelligence, fixate upon you.

XP 1,600,000
Autrone tinkerer 20
LN Large Construct (Outsider)

DEFENSE

AC 40, touch 18, flat-footed 32 (+8 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size, +5 deflection, +6 shield)
hp 400 (20d10+200)
Fort +20, Ref +18, Will +20
Defensive Abilities Aberrant Construction; Resist (cold, fire, electricity) 30, Immune disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, precision-based damage, critical hits; DR 15/adamantine; SR 35

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +30 (2d8+10)
Ranged Arcane Blaster +28/+23/+18/+13 (2d8 force + 2d6 fire)
Special Attacks Integrated Flamethrower (4d6 fire, 30-ft. cone, Reflex DC 28 half, 3 + Con modifier/day), Overload Burst (10d6 electricity, 30-ft. radius, Reflex DC 28 half, 1/day)

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 26, Con 30, Int 28, Wis 20, Cha 18
Base Atk +20; CMB +31, CMD 50
Feats Armor Plating (x3), Enhanced Vision Lenses, Integrated Flamethrower, Rapid Reassembly, Tangible Innovation, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Combat Reflexes
Skills Craft (Alchemy) +38, Craft (Engineering) +38, Disable Device +33, Knowledge (Arcana) +38, Knowledge (Engineering) +38, Perception +35, Spellcraft +38, Use Magic Device +32

Force Field Emitter: Grants 2d10 + Int modifier temporary hit points, adds DR 10/magic.
Healing Injector: Heals 2d8 hit points, adds 2d4 temporary hit points, and removes one condition (dazed, fatigued, or sickened)
Portable Workshop: The autrone tinkerer can repair non-magical items in half the normal time, grants +4 bonus to Craft checks, increases the speed of repairs by 100%, and allows repair of magical items (up to 20 gp value).
Speed Booster: Grants +30 feet to movement speed for 5 minutes and allows an additional move action for 2 rounds.
